reasons: The Agreement's termination section (p0032–p0033) addresses only notice, payment of accrued fees and assignment of Works in progress; no transition assistance, data return/export or deletion mechanic appears anywhere cited, so 'missing' is the correct classification and an insert is the right remedy under the rule's detection guidance for a services agreement.

The inserted subsection (c) is actionable and tracks the model language at the preferred position (six months' assistance at then-current rates, return within 30 days in machine-readable format, then deletion with written certification), and it is properly localized as a new clause in the termination section using the document's own defined terms (Company, Contractor, Works, Confidential Information).

The edit is additive only — no existing text is altered or weakened — so it is the smallest edit that reaches the playbook position; deterministic checks confirm the operation applies and the data-return/transition language is present.
The comment is accurate, in the required voice and prefix, explains what changed and why in two sentences, and offers the 90-day fallback without lecturing.

No double-flagging risk identified: the confidentiality provision imposes only use/disclosure restrictions with no return-or-destroy obligation, and the ownership section addresses title rather than delivery or exit.
